description:
Put the Flutter Martech library into ChatUltra and prove it works.

ChatUltra is the pilot for flutter_martech for one reason: it is the only confirmed Flutter app in the portfolio. Everything the bridge claims is untested until a real Flutter app uses it.

Same shape as the AI Design pilot (MTSDK-55): integrate first, verify second.

Blocked by the Flutter library existing and being installable (MTSDK-3).

Open: ChatUltra is an M&A app worked by an external team, and the Flutter bench is unconfirmed. Who does this integration is not decided.

Acceptance criteria:
- ChatUltra ships with flutter_martech
- No 3rd-party SDK is initialised directly by the app
- The verification suite is green
- Time-to-integrate is recorded and compared against the AI Design baselines
